<｜ref｜>sub_title<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,71,345,88]]<｜/box｜> SERVICES AGREEMENT 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,106,696,178]]<｜/box｜> This Agreement is made on 1 July 2025 between Noble & Sons Ltd, a company registered in England (No. 08841207), whose registered office is at 14 Fenwick Yard, London EC2M 4QP (the "Provider"), and Calder Precision Works GmbH, Stuttgart, Germany (the "Client"). 
<｜ref｜>sub_title<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,197,203,213]]<｜/box｜> 1. Scope 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,213,650,231]]<｜/box｜> The Provider shall deliver the services described in Schedule A. 
<｜ref｜>sub_title<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,250,191,266]]<｜/box｜> 2. Term 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,267,629,284]]<｜/box｜> The initial term is twelve (12) months from the Effective Date.

<｜ref｜>sub_title<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,71,305,88]]<｜/box｜> ### 3. Fees and payment 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,90,647,107]]<｜/box｜> Invoices are issued monthly and payable within thirty (30) days. 
<｜ref｜>sub_title<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,125,266,142]]<｜/box｜> ### 4. Confidentiality 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,143,648,178]]<｜/box｜> Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret and shall use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement. 
<｜ref｜>sub_title<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,197,269,213]]<｜/box｜> ### 5. Governing law 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,214,648,231]]<｜/box｜> This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales. 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,251,474,267]]<｜/box｜> Signed for the Provider: A. Noble, Director 
<｜ref｜>text<｜/ref｜><｜box｜>[[119,269,541,285]]<｜/box｜> Signed for the Client: M. Keller, Managing Director
